arxiv-2302-03794.title: Characterizing the Dark Count Rate of a Large-Format MKID Array Journal: oe Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2302-03794.creator: Noah Swimmer 1,*, W. Hawkins Clay 1, Nicholas Zobrist 1, Benjamin A. Mazin 1, † \dagger
arxiv-2302-03794.description: Abstract We present an empirical measurement of the dark count rate seen in a large-format MKID array identical to those currently in use at observatories such as Subaru on Maunakea. This work provides compelling evidence for their utility in future experiments that require low-count rate, quiet environments such as dark matter direct detection. Across the bandpass from 0.946-1.

arxiv-2307-09289.title: Paranatural Category Theory Journal: PACMPL Volume: 0 0 0
arxiv-2307-09289.creator: Jacob Neumann
arxiv-2307-09289.description: Abstract . We establish and advocate for a novel branch of category theory, centered around strong dinatural transformations (herein known as “paranatural transformations”). Paranatural transformations generalize natural transformations to mixed-variant difunctors, but, unlike other such generalizations, are composable and exceptionally well-behaved.

arxiv-2406-02233.title: Towards Out-of-Distribution Detection in Vocoder Recognition via Latent Feature Reconstruction
arxiv-2406-02233.creator: Renmingyue Du, Jixun Yao, Qiuqiang Kong, Yin Cao
arxiv-2406-02233.description: Abstract Advancements in synthesized speech have created a growing threat of impersonation, making it crucial to develop deepfake algorithm recognition. One significant aspect is out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, which has gained notable attention due to its important role in deepfake algorithm recognition.

arxiv-2411-04150.title: BAPULM: Binding Affinity Prediction using Language Models
arxiv-2411-04150.creator: Radheesh Sharma Meda, Amir Barati Farimani
arxiv-2411-04150.description: Abstract Identifying drug-target interactions is essential for developing effective therapeutics. Binding affinity quantifies these interactions, and traditional approaches rely on computationally intensive 3D structural data. In contrast, language models can efficiently process sequential data, offering an alternative approach to molecular representation.

arxiv-2507-02628.title: Medical Data Pecking: A Context-Aware Approach for Automated Quality Evaluation of Structured Medical Data
arxiv-2507-02628.creator: Irena Girshovitz, Atai Ambus, Moni Shahar, Ran Gilad-Bachrach
arxiv-2507-02628.description: Abstract Background: The use of Electronic Health Records (EHRs) for epidemiological studies and artificial intelligence (AI) training is increasing rapidly. The reliability of the results depends on the accuracy and completeness of EHR data. However, EHR data often contain significant quality issues, including misrepresentations of subpopulations, biases, and systematic errors, as they are primarily collected for clinical and billing purposes.

arxiv-2507-05801.title: The problem of infinite Spin for parabolic and collision solutions in the planar n n -body problem Thanks: This work is supported by the National Key R&D Program of China (2020YFA0713303), NSFC (No. 12171253), Nankai Zhide Fundation and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities.
arxiv-2507-05801.creator: Zhe Wang, Guowei Yu
arxiv-2507-05801.description: Abstract . In the planar n n -body problem, the problem of infinite spin occurs for both parabolic and collision solutions. Recently Moeckel and Montgomery [ 14 ] showed that there is no infinite spin for total collision solutions. Following their approach, we show it can not happen for both complete and partially parabolic solutions.

arxiv-2510-02729.title: Accuracy Law for the Future of Deep Time Series Forecasting
arxiv-2510-02729.creator: Yuxuan Wang, Haixu Wu, Yuezhou Ma, Yuchen Fang, Ziyi Zhang, Yong Liu, Shiyu Wang, Zhou Ye, Yang Xiang, Jianmin Wang, Mingsheng Long
arxiv-2510-02729.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuxuan Wang, Haixu Wu, Yuezhou Ma, Yuchen Fang, Ziyi Zhang, Yong Liu, Shiyu Wang, Zhou Ye, Yang Xiang, Jianmin Wang, Mingsheng Long. Deep time series forecasting has emerged as a booming direction in recent years. Despite the exponential growth of community interests, researchers are sometimes confused about the direction of their efforts due to minor improvements on standard benchmarks.

arxiv-2512-10904.title: A Stellar Magnesium to Silicon ratio in the atmosphere of an exoplanet
arxiv-2512-10904.creator: Jorge A. Sanchez, Peter C. B. Smith, Krishna Kanumalla, Luis Welbanks, Michael R. Line †, Stefan Pelletier, Steven Desch, Patrick Young, Jennifer Patience, Jacob Bean, Matteo Brogi, Dan Jaffe, Gregory N. Mace, Megan Weiner Mansfield, Vatsal Panwar, Vivien Parmentier, Lorenzo Pino, Arjun Baliga Savel
arxiv-2512-10904.description: Abstract The elemental compositions of exoplanets encode information about their formation environments and internal structures. While volatile ratios such as carbon-to-oxygen (C/O) are used to trace formation location, the rock-forming elements—magnesium (Mg), silicon (Si), and iron (Fe)—govern interior mineralogy and are commonly assumed to reflect the host star’s abundances. Yet this assumption remains largely untested.

arxiv-2512-21588.title: A stabilized virtual element framework for the steady state Boussinesq equation with temperature-dependent parameters
arxiv-2512-21588.creator: Sudheer Mishra, Sundararajan Natarajan, Natarajan E
arxiv-2512-21588.description: Abstract This work presents a new conforming stabilized virtual element method for the generalized Boussinesq equation with temperature-dependent viscosity and thermal conductivity. A gradient-based local projection stabilization method is introduced in the discrete formulation to circumvent the violation of the discrete inf-sup condition. The well-posedness of the continuous problem is established under sufficiently small datum.

pmc-11371673.title: Nature of back slopping kombucha fermentation process: insights from the microbial succession, metabolites composition changes and their correlations
pmc-11371673.creator: Ting Liao, Xiang-Ru Li, Li Fan, Bo Zhang, Wei-Ming Zheng, Jia-Jia Hua, Li Li, Norlia Mahror, Lai-Hoong Cheng
pmc-11371673.description: Kombucha, a fermented tea prepared with a symbiotic culture of bacteria and yeast (SCOBY), offers a unique and unpredictable home-brewed fermentation process. Therefore, the need for a controlled kombucha fermentation process has become evident, which requiring a thorough understanding of the microbial composition and its relationship with the metabolites produced.

pmc-11604861.title: Alopecia Areata Treatment Patterns and Satisfaction: Results of a Real-World Cross-Sectional Survey in Europe
pmc-11604861.creator: Peter Anderson, James Piercy, Jenny Austin, Simran Marwaha, Kent A Hanson, Ernest H Law, Gregor Schaefer, Samantha K Kurosky, Sergio Vañó-Galván
pmc-11604861.description: IntroductionAlopecia areata (AA) is an autoimmune disease that causes scalp, face, and/or body hair loss. Recently, oral treatments with kinases inhibition became the first approved therapies for severe AA. An understanding of the use and effectiveness of traditional therapies in real-world treatment settings is needed to guide integration of novel therapies into the treatment paradigm.

pmc-11648308.title: Representing the Needs of Rural Caregivers of People Living With Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementias Through User Personas
pmc-11648308.creator: Anna Jolliff, Jordan R Hill, Matthew Zuraw, Christian Elliott, Nicole E Werner
pmc-11648308.description: Background and ObjectivesRural caregivers of people living with Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD) face unique caregiving challenges. Current interventions do not address many of the systemic barriers experienced by rural ADRD caregivers, including barriers related to geography, healthcare services access, and financial insecurity.

pmc-11655023.creator: Unknown
pmc-11655023.description: First Person is a series of interviews with the first authors of a selection of papers published in Disease Models & Mechanisms, helping researchers promote themselves alongside their papers. Mireia Sueca-Comes is first author on ‘ The role of mesenchymal cells in cholangiocarcinoma’, published in DMM.

pmc-11713578.title: DeepSUVR: Using temporal constraints to improve SUVR and Centiloid quantification
pmc-11713578.creator: Pierrick Bourgeat, Jurgen Fripp, Ashley G Gillman, Timothy Cox, Manu S Goyal, Duygu Tosun, Pamela LaMontagne, Tammie LS Benzinger, Michael S W Weiner, Victor L Villemagne, Colin L Masters, Christopher C Rowe, Vincent Dore
pmc-11713578.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundPET quantification using the Standardised Uptake Value Ratio (SUVR) relies on the availability of a robust reference region. Intrinsic noise, spill in, and specific binding in the reference region can impact the reliability of the resulting SUVR.

pmc-12641928.title: Proteomic Analysis of Plant-Derived hIGF-1-Fc Reveals Proteome Abundance Changes Associated with Wound Healing and Cell Proliferation
pmc-12641928.creator: Kittinop Kittirotruji, Utapin Ngaokrajang, Visarut Buranasudja, Ittichai Sujarittham, San Yoon Nwe, Pipob Suwanchaikasem, Kaewta Rattanapisit, Christine Joy I. Bulaon, Waranyoo Phoolcharoen
pmc-12641928.description: Background: Human insulin-like growth factor 1 (hIGF-1) plays a key role in cell proliferation and tissue repair. While plant expression systems offer a cost-effective and scalable alternative for recombinant protein production, the molecular effects of plant-derived hIGF-1 on mammalian cells remain largely unexplored.

pmc-12652058.title: Confronting Patients’ Refusal to Undergo Treatment: A Cross-Sectional Study of Ethical Attitudes and Intended Behaviour Among Lithuanian Physicians
pmc-12652058.creator: Asta Čekanauskaitė, Karolina Lukošienė, Jelizaveta Krotova, Džiugilė Kersnauskaitė, Benedikt Bachmetjev, Artur Airapetian, Marija Jakubauskienė
pmc-12652058.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Introduction: Refusal to undergo treatment, including one of its manifestations, discharge against medical advice, must be informed, just as consent is, which is considered a core ethical principle in contemporary medical ethics. The aim of this study was to explore physicians’ attitudes and intended behaviour toward patients’ refusal of necessary treatment and to identify factors associated with their clinical decisions in such situations.

pmc-13187359.title: Ectopic adrenocorticotropic hormone syndrome with Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia and pulmonary cryptococcosis: A case report and literature review
pmc-13187359.creator: Junlan Zhou, Chenyang Liu, Lingling Li, Defei Tan, Ying Zhou, Tao Yang
pmc-13187359.description: Ectopic adrenocorticotropic hormone syndrome is a distinct subtype of endogenous Cushing’s syndrome characterized by excessive cortisol secretion, which increases susceptibility to opportunistic infections. Herein, we present the case of a male patient in his early 40s who was admitted with fatigue and bilateral lower-extremity edema. Laboratory tests revealed markedly elevated serum adrenocorticotropic hormone and cortisol levels.

pmc-13373893.title: Mechanical Intelligence in Bone Regeneration: Bridging Material and Cellular Memory for Enhanced Healing
pmc-13373893.creator: Jin Tian, Guoyou Huang, Yang Chen, Teng Ma, Bo Cheng, Feng Xu, XiaoKang Li, Pei Yang, Ting Wen
pmc-13373893.description: Mechanical cues shape bone regeneration, but treatments for delayed union, nonunion, and mechanically mismatched repair often still treat them as static constraints. In this review, we use mechanical intelligence to describe the time‐dependent capacity of biomaterials, cells, and therapeutic devices to store, transform, and transmit mechanical history during repair. Two forms of memory are central to this view.

pmc-13453119.title: Optical coherence tomography-guided decision-making for Descemet stripping automated endothelial keratoplasty in Ahmed glaucoma valve-related corneal decompensation
pmc-13453119.creator: Vijay Kumar Sharma, Prabhjot Singh, Gaurav Kapoor, Vikas Ambiya, Sagrika Patyal
pmc-13453119.description: ObjectiveAhmed glaucoma valve (AGV) implantation can lead to corneal decompensation in a significant proportion of patients. Anterior segment optical coherence tomography (ASOCT) evaluation may serve as a crucial tool for assessing AGV retention versus explantation and for planning Descemet stripping automated endothelial keratoplasty (DSAEK) in such cases.

pmc-13529885.title: Prologue: language abilities in persons with dyslexia
pmc-13529885.creator: Tiffany P Hogan, Norma Hancock
pmc-13529885.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The purpose of this special issue is to showcase current research on language abilities in persons with dyslexia. Although dyslexia is most often defined as a word-level reading and spelling disorder rooted in phonology, a large and growing body of evidence shows that the language difficulties of dyslexia extend well beyond phonology and are too often overlooked in research and practice.

pmc-13640953.title: Potent antitumor preclinical efficacy of B7-H3 chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells in H3G34-mutant, diffuse hemispheric glioma
pmc-13640953.creator: David Akhavan, Monika Yadav, Siddharth Subham, John Jeppson, Omar Tinoco, Scott Chin, Nadine Santana-Magal, Jacqueline Babai, John Szarejko, Garrett Gibson, Kirill Sabitov, Daniel B Zamler, Gary Doug Myers, Brooke L Fridley, Stefan H Bossmann, Kalyani Pyaram, Viveka Nand Yadav
pmc-13640953.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background.Diffuse hemispheric glioma (DHG), H3 G34-mutant, is a highly aggressive and fatal pediatric brain tumor, with a median survival of only ~18 months and no effective targeted therapies. While chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy has shown success in B-cell leukemia and promise in other pediatric central nervous system tumors, it has not yet been evaluated explicitly in preclinical or clinical models of DHG.
